title: Northbeam TechWorks Ledger Reading: Labour Entries a Membership Relief Rests On
content:
Which labour on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job the membership relief is worked out on turns on whether any payment has been received against the job and on how many attendances the job carries labour for.

1. Where a payment has already been received on the job and the job carries labour for two or more attendances, the labour booked for the day the crew was last sent out is taken.
2. Where no payment has been received on the job, every labour charge standing on the job is taken.
3. Where neither of those situations holds, the labour standing on the job less the payments already received against it is taken.

The payments and the labour entries are read from the job's service history; the day the crew was last sent out is read from the job itself.

## The three readings side by side

| Payments received on the job | Attendances the job carries labour for | The labour figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| at least one | two or more | the labour booked for the day the crew was last sent out |
| none | any | every labour charge standing on the job |
| at least one | one | the labour standing on the job less the payments already received against it |

The third line is what remains once the first two are excluded: a payment has been received, but the job carries labour for a single attendance only.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No payment received, three labour entries.** A hypothetical job carries labour of 96.40 USD, 182.30 USD and 54.20 USD, with no payment received against it. The second reading governs and the labour figure is 96.40 plus 182.30 plus 54.20, which is 332.90 USD.

**A payment received, one labour entry.** A job carrying a single labour entry of 332.90 USD against which 214.00 USD has been received falls under the third reading, and the labour figure is 332.90 less 214.00, which is 118.90 USD.

**A payment received, three labour entries.** The three entries above, with the 182.30 USD entry booked for the day the crew was last sent out and 214.00 USD received against the job, fall under the first reading, and the labour figure is 182.30 USD.
